en-US.expectation.configpage: The install options page: a dark borderless window with a background image and rounded corners, a language selector, a minimise button and a close button in the top right, a logo and a tagline image in the middle, and below them the install button, the install folder field, the checkboxes, the version line and the agreement line. The button, the version line and the agreement text read in the language the picture was taken in. Missing glyphs drawn as boxes, mojibake, clipped or overlapping text, a blank image, and a region that did not draw are all worth reporting.
en-US.expectation.installingpage: The installing page: the same window with a progress bar across the middle and a status line under it. No install is running while this picture is taken, so the bar may be empty and the status line blank; the page, the bar and the window frame still have to be drawn.
en-US.expectation.finishpage: The finish page: the same window with a logo and a tagline image in the middle, a blue button under them, and a centred completion line near the bottom. The button and the completion line read in the language the picture was taken in.
en-US.expectation.uninstallpage: The uninstall confirmation page: a smaller dark window with a logo at the top, the confirmation question in the middle, a checkbox under it and two buttons at the bottom. The question, the checkbox and both buttons read in the language the picture was taken in.
en-US.expectation.uninstallingpage: The uninstalling page: a smaller dark window with a progress bar across it and a status line under the bar. No uninstall is running while this picture is taken, so the bar may be empty and the status line blank; the bar and the window frame still have to be drawn.
en-US.expectation.uninstallfinishpage: The uninstall finish page: a smaller dark window with a logo at the top, a completion line under it, and one button below. The line and the button read in the language the picture was taken in.

en-US.guide.heading: How to read this page
en-US.guide.cases: What it checks is what {0} says about the case; one that document does not name falls back to the doc comment above it in the sources, or to its own name. The chips beside a case are the behaviours {0} says break with it.
en-US.guide.coverage: The behaviour card pairs every behaviour the coverage document promises with the result this run gave it, so a behaviour nobody ran reads not run rather than being left off the page.
en-US.guide.passed: Passed: the case ran, and every assertion it makes held.
en-US.guide.failed: Failed: one of them did not hold, or the case panicked; its row is tinted and the line the tool printed for it is coloured in Output.
en-US.guide.ignored: Ignored: the case is marked ignored, or it needs something this machine has not got, and the reason is printed under its result.
en-US.guide.normal: A normal run reaches every target below, fails nothing, and skips only what it gives a reason for.

A page is photographed by building a setup that opens it first, so it is drawn rather than reached -- the uninstaller's pages appear without an uninstall having run -- and the checks under each picture are what that capture measured on it.

zh-CN.expectation.configpage: 安装选项页：深色无边框窗口，带背景图和圆角；右上角是语言选择、最小化和关闭按钮，中间是 logo 和它下面的标语图，再往下是安装按钮、安装目录输入框、几个勾选项、版本号和协议行。按钮、版本号和协议文字用的是这张图拍的那种语言。字形缺字画成方块、乱码、文字被裁掉或重叠、图片空白、某块地方没画出来，都值得报。
zh-CN.expectation.installingpage: 正在安装页：和上面同样的窗口，中间一条进度条，下面一行状态文字。拍这张图时并没有在安装，所以进度条可以是空的、状态文字可以是空白；要看的是这一页、进度条和窗口边框确实画出来了。
zh-CN.expectation.finishpage: 安装完成页：和上面同样的窗口，中间是 logo 和它下面的标语图，再下面是蓝色按钮，靠近底部一行居中的完成提示。按钮和完成提示用的是这张图拍的那种语言。
zh-CN.expectation.uninstallpage: 卸载确认页：小一些的深色窗口，顶部是 logo，中间是确认卸载的问句，下面是勾选项和两个按钮。问句、勾选项和两个按钮用的是这张图拍的那种语言。
zh-CN.expectation.uninstallingpage: 正在卸载页：小一些的深色窗口，一条进度条，下面一行状态文字。拍这张图时并没有在卸载，所以进度条可以是空的、状态文字可以是空白；进度条和窗口边框要确实画出来。
zh-CN.expectation.uninstallfinishpage: 卸载完成页：小一些的深色窗口，顶部是 logo，下面一行完成提示和一个按钮。提示和按钮用的是这张图拍的那种语言。

zh-CN.guide.heading: 怎么看这一页
zh-CN.guide.cases: 「检查什么」取自 {0} 对这条用例的说明；那份文档里没写的，按源码里用例上方的文档注释读，没有注释的就按用例名读。用例旁边的小标签是 {0} 说会随它一起坏掉的行为。
zh-CN.guide.coverage: 「逐条行为」一节把覆盖文档承诺的每一条行为和这次给它的结果对起来，没跑到的写「未跑到」，不会从页面上消失。
zh-CN.guide.passed: 通过：用例跑完了，它做的每一条断言都成立。
zh-CN.guide.failed: 失败：有断言不成立，或者用例 panic；它那一行标红，工具为它打印的原始行在「输出」里也标红。
zh-CN.guide.ignored: 忽略：用例标了 ignore，或者它需要这台机器没有的东西；原因印在它的结果下面。
zh-CN.guide.normal: 正常的一轮：下面每个目标都跑到，没有失败，跳过的都写了原因。
